name: BYOD
description: Build Your Own Distortion: circuit-modelled guitar and effects processor.
about:
Build Your Own Distortion is a modular guitar and effects processor. Chain circuit-modelled distortion, tone-shaping and dynamics blocks into custom signal paths, including parallel and multi-band routing.

Free and open source from Chowdhury DSP.
notes: Windows installer is Inno Setup (verified by signature). The macOS DMG is handled by mounting it and copying any bundles, or running a .pkg if one is present.
